draft.summary: NFL.com graded him 6.37, the 32nd-best grade among 261 2022 draftees and 3rd of 20 at S. He lasted until pick 62, well after his grade rank (32nd): he slid relative to the published grade. Published comparison: Julian Blackmon. Testing was middle of the pack for his position, with no result in the top or bottom 20%. College production: his final season (2021) ranked 1st in tackles among the 19 Ss in his class with stats.

current.summary: Year 5 pro, currently with the Cincinnati Bengals. 62 career games and 47 starts over 4 completed seasons, plus 3 so far in 2026. His 2025 season (7 AV) was his best yet. Strengths in 2025: approximate value 7 (90th percentile), missed tackle rate 4.5% (90th percentile), combined tackles 85 (76th percentile). Weak spots: passer rating allowed 128.5 (9th percentile), interceptions 0 (22nd percentile). Versus the typical Year-4 safety who played: 82.4% season snap share against a median of 72.3%, above the norm.
